stock.description: 360 Ludashi Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, focusing on the development of specialized utility software for personal computers and mobile devices. Its operations span both the People's Republic of China and international markets. Central to its offerings is the Ludashi Software, widely recognized for its specialized benchmarking and monitoring services for PC and smartphone hardware and systems. The enterprise has also diversified, operating online gaming platforms, providing digital advertising, and offering maintenance and repair services for smartphones and computers. Furthermore, it retails a diverse array of electronics, including certified refurbished and new factory smartphones, smart accessories, and other devices, sold via both internet-based and physical outlets. Established in 2014, the company is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
